data.description: As a landmark effort to accelerating the digitization of global public health resources, digitalizing the countries increasingly invest in digital technologies for health, WHO  need to build support for digital health across its core functions. To date, there is no documentation of procedures for systematically translating WHO’s recommendations into digital health systems in a software-neutral manner.

 /* --- NEW TABLE STYLES START --- */

/* 1. Base Table Container & Modern Look */
.smart-guidelines-table {
    width: 100%; 
    border-collapse: collapse; 
    margin: 20px 0; 
    /* Add subtle shadow and rounded corners for a modern "lifted" feel */
    border: none; /* Remove default border to rely on shadow/background */
    box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), 0 2px 4px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
    border-radius: 8px;
    overflow: hidden; /* Important for containing rounded corners */
}

/* 2. Header Styling (Deep Blue) */
.smart-guidelines-table thead tr {
    background-color: #007eb4; /* Deep WHO Blue */
    color: #ffffff; /* White text for contrast */
}

.smart-guidelines-table th {
    padding: 16px 24px; /* More vertical padding for height */
    text-align: left; 
    border-bottom: none; /* Remove heavy border */
    font-weight: 600; /* Slightly lighter than bold 700 */
    /*text-transform: uppercase;*/
    font-size: 1rem;
}

/* 3. Table Data Cells */
.smart-guidelines-table td {
    padding: 12px 12px; /* Consistent padding */
    border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e7eb; /* Light gray divider (from Tailwind gray-200) */
    vertical-align: middle; 
}

/* 4. Alternating Rows and Hover */
.smart-guidelines-table tbody tr {
    transition: background-color 0.15s ease;
}

.smart-guidelines-table tbody tr:nth-child(odd) {
    background-color: #ffffff; /* Pure white */
}

.smart-guidelines-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) {
    background-color: #f9fafb; /* Very light gray (from Tailwind gray-50) */
}

/* Add a hover effect for interactivity (light blue) - FIXED COMMENT BLOCK /
.smart-guidelines-table tbody tr:hover {
    background-color: #eff6ff !important; /* Light blue on hover (from Tailwind blue-50) /
} */

/* 5. Column Widths (Adjusted for 5 columns) */
.smart-guidelines-table td:nth-child(1) { /* Health Domain + Image */
    width: 10%; 
    font-weight: 500;
} 

.smart-guidelines-table td:nth-child(2) { /* Publication Date */
    width: 10%; 

} 

.smart-guidelines-table td:nth-child(3) { /* L2: DAK Kits */
    width: 20%; 
} 
      
.smart-guidelines-table td:nth-child(4) { /* L2: DAK Components */
    width: 30%; 
} 

.smart-guidelines-table td:nth-child(5) { /* L3: FHIR Implementation Guides */
    width: 20%; 
} 

/* 6. Link and List Styling with ICONS */
.smart-guidelines-table ul {
    margin: 0;
    padding-left: 0; 
    list-style-type: none; 
    text-decoration: none !important;
}

.smart-guidelines-table li {
    margin-bottom: 8px; 
    text-decoration: none !important;
}

.smart-guidelines-table td a,
.smart-guidelines-table ul li a {
    color: #1e40af !important; 
    text-decoration: none !important; /* This applies to all links in the table */
    border-bottom: none !important; 
    transition: color 0.2s;
    display: inline-block; 
}

/* NEW RULE ADDED FOR HIGH SPECIFICITY ON LIST ITEMS */
.smart-guidelines-table td a,
.smart-guidelines-table ul li a {
    text-decoration: none !important;
} 

/* NEW FIX: Specifically target links inside UL/LI within the smart-guidelines-table */
.smart-guidelines-table td ul li a {
    text-decoration: none !important;
    border-bottom: none !important;
} 

.smart-guidelines-table a:hover {
    color: #1d4ed8 !important; 
    text-decoration: underline !important; 
    border-bottom: none !important; 
    background-color: transparent !important;
}



/* --- ICON GENERATION RULES ADDED BELOW --- */

/* Base style for all link icons */
.smart-guidelines-table a::before {
    margin-right: 8px; /* Spacing between icon and link text */
    font-size: 1.1em;
    opacity: 0.8;
}

/* NEW: Icon for GitHub links (using Font Awesome) */
.smart-guidelines-table li.github-link::before {
    /* CRITICAL FA PROPERTIES FOR SOLID ICONS */
    font-family: 'Font Awesome 5 Brands'; 
    font-weight: 900; 
    font-style: normal;
    font-variant: normal;
    text-rendering: auto;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    display: inline-block; /* Helps with positioning */
    
    /* ICON AND STYLING */
    content: "\f09b"; /* fa-fire Unicode */
    color: #181717; 
    margin-right: 8px; 
}

.smart-guidelines-table li.fhir-link::before {
    /* CRITICAL FA PROPERTIES FOR SOLID ICONS */
    font-family: 'Font Awesome 5 Solid'; 
    font-weight: 900; 
    font-style: normal;
    font-variant: normal;
    text-rendering: auto;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    display: inline-block; /* Helps with positioning */
    
    /* ICON AND STYLING */
    content: "\f06d"; /* fa-fire Unicode */
    color: #181717; 
    margin-right: 8px; 
}

.smart-guidelines-table li.xls-link::before {
    /* CRITICAL FA PROPERTIES FOR REGULAR ICONS */
    font-family: 'Font Awesome 5 Regular'; 
    font-weight: 400; /* NOTE: This is the difference for Regular icons */
    font-style: normal;
    font-variant: normal;
    text-rendering: auto;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    display: inline-block;
    
    /* ICON AND STYLING */
    content: "\f1c3"; /* fa-file-excel Unicode */
    color: #1d6f42;
    margin-right: 8px; 
}

/* New CSS class for a PDF icon (fa-file-pdf - Solid) */

.smart-guidelines-table td.pdf-link::before {
    /* CRITICAL FA PROPERTIES FOR SOLID ICONS */
    font-family: 'Font Awesome 5 Solid'; 
    font-weight: 900; 
    
    /* ICON AND STYLING */
    content: "\f1c1"; /* Unicode for fa-file-pdf */
    color: #b30b00; /* Standard PDF red color */
    margin-right: 8px; 
    vertical-align: top;
    margin-top: 3px;
    
    /* Ensure proper rendering */
    font-style: normal;
    font-variant: normal;
    text-rendering: auto;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    display: inline-block;
}


.smart-guidelines-table li.pdf-link::before {
    /* CRITICAL FA PROPERTIES FOR SOLID ICONS */
    font-family: 'Font Awesome 5 Solid'; 
    font-weight: 900; 
    
    /* ICON AND STYLING */
    content: "\f1c1"; /* Unicode for fa-file-pdf */
    color: #b30b00; /* Standard PDF red color */
    margin-right: 8px; 
    vertical-align: top;

    /* Ensure proper rendering */
    font-style: normal;
    font-variant: normal;
    text-rendering: auto;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    display: inline-block;
}

/* Ultimate Specificity Fix for List Item Underlines */
.smart-guidelines-table tbody tr td ul li a,
.smart-guidelines-table td ul li a:visited,
.smart-guidelines-table tbody tr td ul li a:hover,
.smart-guidelines-table tbody tr td ul li a:focus {
    text-decoration: none !important;
    border-bottom: none !important; /* Ensure border-bottom isn't the culprit */
    background-color: transparent !important; /* Prevents background on hover/focus from other rules */
}

/* --- ULTIMATE OVERRIDE USING CUSTOM LIST ITEM CLASSES --- */

/* 1. Target XLS links across all states */
.smart-guidelines-table li.xls-link a,
.smart-guidelines-table li.xls-link a:hover,
.smart-guidelines-table li.xls-link a:focus {
    text-decoration: none !important;
    border-bottom: none !important; 
    background-color: transparent !important;
}

/* 2. Target FHIR links across all states */
.smart-guidelines-table li.fhir-link a,
.smart-guidelines-table li.fhir-link a:hover,
.smart-guidelines-table li.fhir-link a:focus {
    text-decoration: none !important;
    border-bottom: none !important; 
    background-color: transparent !important;

/* 3. Target GitHub links across all states */
.smart-guidelines-table li.github-link a,
.smart-guidelines-table li.github-link a:hover,
.smart-guidelines-table li.github-link a:focus {
    text-decoration: none !important;
    border-bottom: none !important;

/* 4. Target PDF links across all states (used for DDCC items) */
.smart-guidelines-table li.pdf-link a,

/* 5. Catch-all for any other link inside a table list */
.smart-guidelines-table td ul li a,
.smart-guidelines-table td ul li a:focus {
    text-decoration: none !important;
    border-bottom: none !important; 
    background-color: transparent !important;
}

.smart-guidelines-table td ul li a:hover,
.smart-guidelines-table td ul li a:focus,
.smart-guidelines-table li.fhir-link a:hover,
.smart-guidelines-table li.fhir-link a:focus,
.smart-guidelines-table li.pdf-link a:hover,
.smart-guidelines-table li.pdf-link a:focus,
.smart-guidelines-table li.xls-link a:hover,
.smart-guidelines-table li.xls-link a:focus,
.smart-guidelines-table li.github-link a:hover,
.smart-guidelines-table li.github-link a:focus {
text-decoration: underline !important;
}
